description: This file defines a REST controller named TransactionController in a Spring Boot application. It handles HTTP POST requests for fund transfer and utility payment operations, delegating processing to TransactionService.

classes.name: TransactionController
classes.description: REST controller that provides endpoints for fund transfer and utility payment operations within the core banking service.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to initiate a fund transfer, logs the request, delegates to TransactionService, and returns the response.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests to initiate a utility payment, logs the request, delegates to TransactionService, and returns the response.
